ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, in which organism names such as foxes, sheep, eagles, insects, Plants, rabbits, echidnas, mallee fowls, and cats are labeled. Among them, “Plants” is located in the middle position of the diagram, and there are arrows from Plants pointing to some animals. Reasoning: The question asks “What is a producer?” In a food web, producer refers to an organism that can make its own food and is located at the base of the food chain, usually a plant. The animals in the diagram are all consumers, and only Plants is a producer. Therefore the answer in singular common form is plant.
